task: Show agents working with each other in the Workspace Monitor UI.

expected_items.description: The UI must show agents working with each other instead of only listing agents.
The generated snapshot must include agent collaboration data derived from coordination status and agent configs.
The UI must show work lanes and agent-task-project flow so collaboration can be understood visually.
The UI must expose blockers and next actions when task data includes them.
Collector tests must cover lane grouping so collaboration data does not silently regress.
Implement live websocket/event-store tracing of running agents.
expected_items.rationale: The request can be satisfied by making current coordination state visible in the static monitor. Real-time tracing needs separate runtime/event-store design.

artifact_checks.purpose: Render collaboration board and flow UI.
Style collaboration lanes and flow map responsively.
Record timing and bottleneck data for the task.

acceptance_checks.description: Collector tests include collaboration lane grouping.
Generated snapshot contains collaborationBoard summary, lanes, and flows.
Workspace Monitor type check and static build pass.

known_omission_risks: The current UI is static-snapshot based; real-time agent trace streaming remains future work.
Only one runtime coordination agent is registered today, so the board is structurally ready but not yet visually crowded with multiple live agents.
notes: This change makes collaboration visible from existing coordination data without adding a new runtime dependency.
